frozen_before: Any biological replay-order association; responds to negative real RUN predictive scores in 23 of 26 bounded-v3 periods
scope: RUN-only development diagnostic, not estimator selection, endpoint certification or biological calibration
cell_rule: First eight unit IDs in the existing frozen bank order, unchanged between candidates and PRE/POST; no spike-count, prediction-quality or outcome ranking
pause_rule: Every pause in the independently verified source cohort; preserve the three frozen theta-screen failures without replacement
unchanged: Original physical RUN clocks, theta references and missingness, position/direction/speed covariates, 5-second guarded two-fold crossfit, zero-spike bins, 60-ms guard, bounded log-speed scaling, likelihood, pseudocount and convergence tolerance
readout: Held-out Poisson score relative to the training-only global-rate model, retained separately for every fixed cell and period. Report model dimension, training spike support, prediction range and extrapolation. PRE/POST quality is not a biological change result.
selection: Report every candidate. Do not select a winner, fit replay associations, drop unfavorable periods or authorize inference from the best candidate. Any future estimator selection must be training-only and separately calibrated.
claim_boundary: Neither improved rate prediction on eight cells nor numerical agreement proves unbiased coordination changes or replay-induced plasticity. The original PF goal and independent replay validation remain unfinished.
